claim_text: Fleischman said that the reported/video-shared attack on a Palestinian on Jerusalem Day was fake.
discovery_sources: The Seventh Eye 2024 report; Times of Israel 2023-05-18 Jerusalem Day report; Jerusalem Post 2023-05-18 Jerusalem Day report; renewed Channel 14/YouTube/Hebrew/English provenance searches
resolution_notes: Counter-evidence context was narrowed: The Seventh Eye directly identifies the Channel 14 program as 'The Patriots' in June 2023 and states that the referenced Palestinian assault was documented on video; contemporaneous Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post reporting from the May 18 Jerusalem Day Flag March independently documents filmed assaults on Palestinians and attacks on journalists. However, the exact Channel 14 broadcast date/full segment and the uniquely referenced Palestinian assault remain unrecovered among multiple incidents that day. No adverse verdict is forced; origin remains recurring panelist Itamar Fleischman, not Channel 14 editorial speech.
media_status: Exact original Channel 14 clip remains Blocked; contemporaneous Jerusalem Day footage is counter-evidence context only and must not be substituted as the claim preview.
